result:
T-DG7-ARCH-05 is finished: both ADRs, the three work-split sections, the contract and the handback are written, and every acceptance check exited 0. This run built the design and contract only. No route, screen, guide or tool exists yet; those belong to the implementers named in the work split.

**Checks (all exit 0; logs in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG7/T-DG7-ARCH-05-evidence/`):**
- `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG6`: PASS, at the start and again at the end.
- `pnpm openapi:lint`: PASS, 965 operations.
- `pnpm -r typecheck` and `pnpm lint`.
- Migrations and contract integration tests on a disposable PostgreSQL 16.15: 28 files and 705 tests passed. The contract test now counts 965 operations, including the 3 new ones still waiting for their routes.
- A targeted set of unit tests: 35 files and 550 tests passed.
- The whole-tree Prettier check, the claims scan and the payload secret scan.
- No guard probe ran, because there is no migration to probe.

**What was delivered:**
- **ADR-0071 (traceability and honest completion):**
  - The in-app register reads a snapshot of `requirements.csv` taken at build time. Nothing in the product reads delivery records while running.
  - Three new read-only operations: list requirements, get one requirement, and About.
  - The release module's guard table (G1–G8), with each rule mapped to a test and an owner.
  - About lists every unfinished row with its missing dependency. Anything missing shows as Unknown, never as zero or an empty list.
  - The spec for the release-notes generator, which DO-J will build.
  - The unfinished-items section of the release notes is also the release-blocker list, so the two can't drift.
  - It records DO-I's protocol-audit checks (C1–C9) and the D-249 disclosure, without re-specifying the tool.
- **ADR-0072 (handover documentation set):**
  - The `docs/handover/` tree.
  - The language rule from D-243 Q7, with Arabic marked provisional.
  - Seven anchors for the deployment guide's seven topics.
  - A role matrix generated from `permissions.ts`.
  - A known-limitations guide with generated sections, including the protocol-audit hits.
  - Checks T-H1–T-H9, which cover D-247 O3 and O5.
- **Work split §I, §H, §J:** owners and files, exact English and Arabic texts, tests T-I1–T-I17 each tied to the requirement clause it proves, and how each of the 16 J rows is evidenced.
- **Contract and records:**
  - No migration and no new permission code, so `0153`–`0155` stay free.
  - Locks 730418–730419 are reserved but not allocated.
  - The ERD, data dictionary and permissions matrix each have a new section (ERD §1af, matrix §33).

**Decisions you need to make (handback §4):**
- **O1 – who can see the register.** I used the existing `operations.read` code. That gives ADM_TECH, TO, KDS, TD and AUD access, but the requirement says ADM, AUD and TO. So KDS and TD can see it, and the methodology and access admins cannot. Matching exactly needs a new code and a seed migration. Shipping that migration now would force the implementers adding migrations in this wave to renumber theirs.
- **O2 – validator test.** The validator's rules for BLOCKED rows without notes and IMPLEMENTED rows without evidence have no test. I assigned one to QA-D; you may prefer to add it under `tools/gates/tests/` yourself.
- **O3 – `.dockerignore` change.** The design adds one exception so the image build can read `requirements.csv`. This changes a DG1-approved file. It can only be proven by a real image build on your host; otherwise it stays a disclosed BLOCKED item.
- **O4 – marker for AN-P7.** The analyst must write `completes-after-gate:` into the notes of the six Q19 rows. About and the release notes depend on it, so it needs adding to their assignment.
- **O5 – tool ownership.** I added generator and check tools to DOC-B's and DOC-C's file sets that the plan didn't name. Please confirm.
- **O6 – keys for FE-A.** FE-A needs to add one problem key and two navigation entries before FE-C starts.

All Arabic text is provisional and unreviewed. The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG7/T-DG7-ARCH-05-solution-architect.md`.
